card.name: Start of intrathecal, intramuscular, intravascular
card.fires_on: The first piece " intr" of route-of-administration words such as intrathecal, intramuscular and intravascular, before the rest of the word is written. It appears in injection and dosing text.

modes.label: Intramuscular or intravascular
modes.description: Start of "intramuscular" or "intravascular" after "intravenously or" or "an".
modes.example: Ceftriaxone for injection may be administered intravenously or<< intr>>amuscularly.

card.writes: It seems to push the model to finish the word with the right ending, but the listed tokens show no clear effect.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of route words like intrathecal or intramuscular, just before the rest of the word.
